content: In this task, the model identifies causal explanations given the discourse arguments of the causality message. We explored over the same models as those we used for causality (sans the output layer), and found the almost opposite trend of performances (see Table 5 ). The Linear SVM obtained lowest F1 while the LSTM model made the best identification performance. As opposed to the simple binary classification of the causality messages, in order to detect causal explanation, it is more beneficial to consider the relation across discourse arguments of the whole message and implicit distributional representation due to the implicit causal relations between two distant arguments.
